scripts.verify:ipc: npm --workspace apps/desktop run build:electron && electron scripts/verify-ipc.cjs
scripts.verify:startup:mac: npm --workspace apps/desktop run build:electron && node scripts/verify-startup.cjs --platform darwin --arch arm64
scripts.verify:startup:windows: npm --workspace apps/desktop run build:electron && node scripts/verify-startup.cjs --platform win32 --arch x64
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace packages/shared-types run typecheck && npm --workspace apps/desktop run typecheck
